description: Which signed audit records can I export for verification? Returns chained audit rows, decided-action feature snapshots and signed anchors; use it for a portable tamper-evident export instead of gate_read_audit's recent-call view, then check it with gate_verify_audit_proof. No sealed paths/bodies, notes, keys or IPs in the action labels. Legacy actions lack snapshots and are excluded. store_audit=false has no chain. Follow next_from for audit rows and next_actions_after as actions_after for labels (10,000 each). Use API/SDK to verify exports above the MCP request size limit. The signature is HMAC-SHA256. This also expires overdue held actions in the project and clears their stored request paths and bodies.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from project creation on the setup endpoint (/mcp/setup), e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_export_audit_proof
title: Export a signed audit proof
